* '''Playtest''' ([[D'Qar (Playtest)]], 1 August 2019): Playtest image, published before the set's official release (2 August 2019) and replaced before it. Players Committee card image, 1 August 2019: [[:File:V11-D-dqar-20190801.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e26d0f1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/dqar.gif Holotable commit e26d0f1 “Images part 1”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “Unless your Resistance leader here, Force drain -1 here.” Dark Side: “Once per turn, if you just moved a [First Order] starship to here, may activate 2 Force.”
* '''Original''' ([[D'Qar]], 2 August 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (2 August 2019). Players Committee card image, 2 August 2019: [[:File:V11-D-dqar-20190802.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/60afbbd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/dqar.gif Holotable commit 60afbbd “Using better graphics”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “Unless your Resistance leader here, Force drain -1 here.” Dark Side: “Once per turn, if you just moved a [First Order] starship to here, may activate 2 Force.” '''What changed:''' re-rendered on release day with sharper graphics; same words.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[D'Qar (Errata)]], 19 October 2019): Players Committee card image, 19 October 2019: [[:File:V11-D-dqar-20191019.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9d5adb2/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/dqar.gif Holotable commit 9d5adb2 “D'qar flip fix”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “Unless your Resistance leader here, Force drain -1 here.” Dark Side: “Once per turn, if you just moved a [First Order] starship to here, may activate 2 Force.” '''What changed:''' the image was re-uploaded turned 180° (Holotable commit “D'qar flip fix”): the Dark Side text is now at the bottom; same picture and words. Listed as its own version under Bill's ruling of 12 November 2026 (18:48: every published image that differs from the previous one is a version).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page, 29 March 2023): Players Committee card image, 29 March 2023: [[:File:V11-D-dqar-20230329.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/168657a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/hires/dqar.png Holotable commit 168657a “Set 11 Remastered”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “Unless your Resistance leader here, Force drain -1 here.” Dark Side: “Once per turn, if you just moved a [First Order] starship to here, may activate 2 Force.” '''What changed:''' Set 11 remaster: same words; the card is re-rendered at high resolution (new credit line “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”).
*: [[File:V11-D-dqar-20230329-changes.png|frameless|upright=2.6|alt=Before and after]] ''Before (left) and after (right): cropped from the published images.''

Text: Light Side: “Once per game, may ▼ Connix, Paige, or Tallie here.” Dark Side: “Once per game, if you just moved a [First Order] starship to here, may activate 2 Force.” '''What changed:''' Light Side “Unless your Resistance leader here, Force drain -1 here.” became “Once per game, may ▼ Connix, Paige, or Tallie here.”; Dark Side “Once per turn” became “Once per game”. The image is stored turned 180° from the remaster (Light Side text at the bottom).
